mechanism_criteria.selected_event: M-CSA211 proposal1 step1, NADH-to-FMN reductive half reaction
mechanism_criteria.prediction_target_state: Reduced NADH plus oxidized FMN, noncovalent reactants
mechanism_criteria.basis: Literature-supported author operational proximity screen; <=3.8 A is a favorable-distance guideline, not a case-calibrated catalytic boundary.
mechanism_criteria.aggregation: Both declared sites must pass, with distinct independent nearest-pocket occupancy matching the bijections. Two ligand pairs at one pocket cannot satisfy two sites. No cross-site minima or mixing samples.
mechanism_criteria.pairing: Protein CA Kabsch to 1IDT reference; NADH nonreactive whole-heavy centroid and FMN ring centroid excluding N5 separately assigned bijectively to reference FMN pocket centroids excluding N5. No donor C4, acceptor N5 or success value used for site assignment.
mechanism_criteria.scope: Hydride donor-acceptor heavy-atom proximity only. Not full catalytic competence, barrier, rate, explicit H trajectory or pro-R/pro-S certification.
mechanism_criteria.orientation_policy: Ring approach and ring-plane geometry reported continuously; no uncalibrated numeric angle gate. Literature re-face requirement acknowledged; stereospecific H transfer not certified by distance.

references.supports: NADH C4 hydride donor and oxidized FMN N5 acceptor; first half reaction only.
